accommodation: Bedrooms and suites, most with sea views; family suites and connecting rooms.
suitableFor: Families, couples, guests wanting spa and leisure facilities.
beachAccess: About a 2-minute walk to Woolacombe beach.
confirmedFeatures: spa, gym, outdoor heated lido (summer), tennis, pickleball and basketball courts, cinema, Bay Brasserie restaurant, afternoon tea
overview: A large traditional hotel in the centre of Woolacombe, a couple of minutes' walk from the beach. Most rooms look over the bay, and there are family suites. Facilities include a spa, gym, outdoor lido, sports courts and a cinema, with the Bay Brasserie serving all meals.
surfTripFit: Its position near Woolacombe beach and free parking work for surfers wanting comfort, though no board storage or dog policy is stated.
gaps: Dogs, room count and board storage not stated.
